title: Project Deal: Evaluating Claude's Market Negotiation Skills
excerpt: We created a marketplace for employees in our San Francisco office, with one big twist. We tasked Claude with buying, selling and negotiating on our colleagues' behalf.
content: This study explores the emergence of strategic negotiation behaviors in large language models. We observe that models can develop sophisticated bargaining strategies without explicit instruction.

title: Emotion concepts and their function in a large language model
excerpt: All modern language models sometimes act like they have emotions. What's behind these behaviors? Our interpretability team investigates.
content: We mapped the internal activations associated with emotional prompts and found distinct topological features that correspond to different affective states.

title: Constitutional Classifiers: Defending against universal jailbreaks
excerpt: These classifiers filter the overwhelming majority of jailbreaks while maintaining practical deployment. A prototype withstood over 3,000 hours of red teaming.
content: Our new classification architecture provides a robust defense against adversarial attacks by enforcing categorical constraints derived from human-aligned principles.

title: Vibe physics: The AI grad student
excerpt: Exploring how AI models can assist in theoretical physics research by identifying patterns in high-dimensional datasets.
content: We demonstrate that LLMs can accurately predict phase transitions in simulated materials by analyzing the 'vibes' of the underlying mathematical structures.

title: Trustworthy agents in practice
excerpt: A framework for deploying autonomous agents in high-stakes environments while maintaining human oversight and accountability.
content: Our policy brief outlines requirements for the safe integration of AI agents into financial and medical systems.
